parent_programme.relationship: Phase-VI target-aware evidence-design successor; no prior result is altered

scientific_question: When a structured future target is unresolved inside a same-G BAM survivor fiber, can current-state measurements resolve it, or is parameter-sensitive evidence required because dormant aliases share the same present A/B/M/tau state?

targets.binary_future_decision: transformation-specific net loss / loss / gain target

channels: movement first-arrival tau at one node

parameter.semantics: truth-relative exact parameter-coordinate assays in the frozen W1 lattice

evidence_libraries.combined: union of current-state and parameter channels

optimization: for each original truth embedded in W1 and each target, solve the exact minimum truth-relative measurement set that eliminates every same-G W1 survivor with a target value different from truth; same-target worlds need not be eliminated

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one unresolved structured future decision cannot be resolved by any complete library of current-state A/B/M/tau measurements.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if current-state evidence is sufficient for every unresolved future decision.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Every structured future binary decision unresolved at E1 is resolvable by the complete frozen parameter-coordinate library.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any unresolved case after all eight exact parameter coordinates is an implementation/target-definition failure and stops interpretation.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: For each of the three transformations, at least one truth requires fewer parameter-coordinate assays to identify the binary future decision than to identify the exact parameter world.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED separately for a transformation without any strict saving.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: The preregistered S11 climate dormant-alias fiber remains unresolved under the complete current-state library but becomes resolvable under the parameter or combined library.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if the S11 fiber is state-resolvable or parameter evidence cannot resolve it.

secondary_outputs: state-only insufficiency counts by transformation and target
frequency of parameter coordinates appearing in at least one lexicographically canonical exact minimum target-specific design
cost_boundary: Each evidence channel has unit combinatorial cost only for exact finite-set comparison. Channel counts are not claimed to equal monetary, logistical, temporal or ethical field costs.
stop_rules: Do not add new evidence channels after scoring.
Do not change transformation definitions or W1 lattice.
Do not collapse parameter assays and state measurements into a field-cost claim.
Do not add an assay solely to rescue a refuted hypothesis.
Do not alter Phase-I through Phase-V manuscripts or frozen results.
candidate_contribution: Target-aware evidence design over occurrence-conditioned BAM survivor fibers, explicitly distinguishing present-state measurements from latent-parameter measurements when future ecological transformations reactivate dormant aliases.
